title: Member erased
description: A member's personal data was erased in loyalty. The ledger is kept as anonymous totals keyed by the opaque member id, and unused vouchers are voided. The event carries the opaque `memberId` only, so a Tenant can react without loyalty keeping or sending the person's data. The event's `aggregate` is `member/<memberId>`. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

memberId.description: loyalty's own opaque id for the member that was erased.
